body:
STIC Investments, Inc. ( (KR:026890) ) has provided an update.

STIC Investments, Inc. has decided to liquidate its STIC Strategic Credit No.2 Private Equity Limited Partnership after completing the recovery of all investment assets. The fund, which managed KRW 121.0 billion during a term from December 10, 2024, to September 30, 2026, generated KRW 18.904 billion in profit and a KRW 0.906 billion performance fee for the manager.

The liquidation, approved on September 30, 2026, coincides with the partners’ general meeting and occurs before the originally scheduled end of the fund’s term. This early dissolution underscores successful asset recovery and crystallizes performance fees for STIC Investments, marking the closure of a significant credit-focused private equity vehicle for its investors.

More about STIC Investments, Inc.

STIC Investments, Inc. is a Korean investment firm active in private equity and credit-focused funds. The company manages vehicles such as the STIC Strategic Credit No.2 Private Equity Limited Partnership, targeting strategic credit investments and generating performance-based fees from asset recovery and fund management activities.
